div.div: فَأْفَآءٌ (T, S, M, Msb, K) and ↓ فَأْفَأٌ , (T, M, Msb, K, [and thus accord. to my copy of the Mgh,]) both mentioned by Lh, (T,) A man in whom is what is termed فَأْفَأَةٌ, expl. above; (T, S, M, K;) or who reiterates the letter ف much when he speaks; (M;) or who cannot utter the word unless with an effort, commencing with the like of the letter ف, and then pronouncing with effort the letters of the word correctly: (Mgh:) or one who reiterates his words much in speaking: (TA:) fem. with ة. (T, Msb.).
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
